title: HomeStage, round two: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the printed furnishing cotton. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Warm and tactile, distinctive but usable, nothing like Formula.

options.label: Printed Cloth
options.thesis: The page is a length of printed cloth, and choosing a fabric re-prints it in that colourway.
options.viewport: A full-bleed printed ground of large soft shapes drawn from the sofa's camelback curve; the sofa render sits on the cloth; the selvedge strip carries nav and colourway; name, price, Add to cart and Order a sample sit on a sewn-in label patch.
options.risk: Pattern can overwhelm the product if the motif is too busy; needs a disciplined two- or three-ink print.

raised.raise: Lead time is a dated band of weeks from today, each week labelled with what happens to the sofa.
The fabric range is one row of identical cut pieces; the chosen one lifts out of the row.
Selection is shown by form (the chosen piece lifts with a folded corner), never by colour alone.
One loud fragment leads: the colourway name printed large into the cloth.

options.label: The Designer's Sketchbook
options.lineage: interior designers' watercolour sketchbooks and sample boards
options.thesis: The page is a designer's sketchbook spread for this one sofa: washed drawings, pinned swatches, notes in the margin.
options.viewport: An open sketchbook spread: the sofa on the left page with pencil dimension lines, fabric swatches pinned on the right with the buy panel clipped to the page.
options.risk: Familiar warm-paper look, close to the cream-and-serif default; needs real hand-made washes to avoid feeling pasted on.

options.label: Azulejo Hall
options.thesis: The page laid in glazed tiles, cobalt on milk white, panels framed by tile borders.
options.viewport: A tiled panel holds the sofa; tile borders frame the fabric range and price.
options.case: Homeware owners recognise tile and glaze at once; loses on clarity because grout seams cross the product.
options.risk: Only one blue: the fabric colours fight a cobalt world.

options.label: Wrapped Box Kiosk
options.thesis: The sofa as a wrapped box whose lid diagram honestly maps everything inside.
options.viewport: A printed lid with a numbered contents map: frame, springs, fabric, legs, delivery.
options.case: Strong on clarity (a contents map of the piece); weak on identification for furniture owners.
options.risk: Reads as food packaging if the furniture facts don't lead.

options.label: Brine Calendar
options.thesis: Jars maturing on a seasonal shelf.
options.case: Food world; furniture owners do not see themselves in it.
options.kept: A dated band of weeks for the lead time.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.thesis: A row of needles reading the room.
options.case: Instrument world; no home or fabric story.
options.kept: Identical units in one row, the chosen one lifting.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.thesis: Everything hung off one calibrated rail.
options.case: Cold and technical; drifts back toward Formula's hairline family.
options.kept: State shown by form, not colour.

options.label: Raygun Desk
options.thesis: Colliding type you feel before you read.
options.case: Unusable as a shop page; not distinctive-but-usable.
options.risk: Shoppers cannot find price or action.
options.kept: One loud fragment leads the eye.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The furniture product page every shopper expects, done impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Gallery left; name, price, round swatches and Add to cart right.
